book.name: ROMANOS
book.title: RI CARTA RI XUTZ'IBAJ RI SAN PABLO CHQUE RI COJONELAB AJ ROMA

content: Waral cäkil wi ri c'aslemal ri jachom pu k'ab ri Dios

Je c'u ri', kachalal, rumal chi ri Dios sibalaj quel u c'ux chke, quixinbochi'j chi quijach iwib che ri Dios, je' jas jun sipanic ri c'aslic, ri jachom cho ri Dios, ri utz cäril wi ri Are'. We sipanic ri' are wa' ri kas k'ijilanic ri rajwaxic quiban cho ri Dios.

Miban chi iwe ix jas ri cäca'n ri winak cho ruwächulew. Xane chiq'uexa ri i chomabal rech cuban c'ac' ri i c'aslemal. Je ri' kas quiwetamaj na jas ru rayibal ri Dios. Are c'u wa' ri kas utz, ri cäkaj chuwäch, xukuje' ri jicom cho ri Dios.

Rumal ri xsipax chwe rumal ri Dios aretak xutok'obisaj nu wäch, c'o ri quinbij chiwe ix iwonojel: C'o jun chiwe muchomaj chi nim u banic, xane rajwaxic quichomaj iwib chnojimal jas u beyal ri cojonic ri xuya ri Dios chiwe chijujunal.
Ri ka cuerpo e q'uia ru tz'akatil c'olic, man conojel tä c'ut xa junam u wäch ri qui chac.
Je c'u ri' ri uj xukuje'. Pune uj q'uia, xa uj jun cuerpo rumal ri Cristo. Konojel ka nuc'um kib je' jas ru tz'akatil ri ka cuerpo.

Ri Dios u yo'm jalajoj tak cuinem chke, xa jas ri xraj ri Are' xuya chke. Rajwaxic ba' utz qui cojic tak we cuinem ri' cäka'no. We yo'm chke chi cäcowinic cäkak'alajisaj tzij ri cuya ri Lok'alaj Espíritu, ka'na wa' ruc' ri ka cojonic ri c'olic.
We yo'm chke chi cupatänin chque niq'uiaj winak chic, utz ka'na che qui patänixic. We yo'm che jun chi cäcowinic queutijoj niq'uiaj chic, chutzaka u k'ij chubanic wa'.

We yo'm che jun chi cäcowinic cuwalijisaj canima' niq'uiaj chic, chutzak u k'ij chubanic wa'. We yo'm che jun chi cäsipanic, muya xa rumal chi c'o ri craj. We yo'm che jun chi cuc'am qui be niq'uiaj chic, chuna' na jas ri cubano. We c'u yo'm che jun chi queuto' ri c'o qui rajwaxic, chubana wa' ruc' quicotemal.
Waral cäkil wi ri rajwaxic cäca'n ri kachalal cojonelab pa ri qui c'aslemal
Kas chiwaj iwib ri jun ruc' ri jun chic, man cuban tä c'u quieb i c'ux. Chiwetzelaj u wäch ri man utz taj, chitakej c'u u banic ri utz.
Rajwaxic chi quiwaj iwib ri jun ruc' ri jun chic je' ta ne chi kas iwachalal iwib. Chiya i k'ij chbil tak iwib, nim c'ut chiwila wi iwib, ri jun ruc' ri jun chic.
Chicojo i chuk'ab pa ronojel, xak mixsak'orinic. Chipatänij ri Kajaw Jesús ruc' nimalaj quicotemal.
Chixquicot chrij ri cu'l wi i c'ux. Chichajij paciencia pa tak ri c'äx ri quiriko. Chibana orar amak'el ronojel k'ij.
Cheito' ri kachalal cojonelab pa tak ri qui rajwaxic. Utz chibana che qui c'ulaxic ri queopan iwuc'.
Chibochi'j ri Dios pa qui wi' ri queyok'on chiwe. Chita' tok'ob pa qui wi', mita' c'u pa qui wi' chi xa c'äx cäquiriko.
Chixquicot cuc' ri quequicotic. Chixok' c'ut cuc' ri quebok'ic.
Chixoc il chbil tak iwib ri jun che ri jun chic. Miban i nimal, xane chiwachilaj iwib cuc' ri man nimak tä qui banic. Michomaj chi c'o na iwetambal ix chquiwäch niq'uiaj chic.
Miya rajil u q'uexel ri c'äx ri cäban chiwe. Chicojo i chuk'ab chubanic ri utz chquiwäch conojel ri winak.
Chibana ronojel ri quixcowin chubanic rech cäc'oji utzil chixol cuc' conojel ri winak.

Lok'alaj tak kachalal, miyac iwib ix chquij ri i c'ulel, xane chiya can che ri Dios chi cuc'äjisaj qui wäch. Cubij ya' ru Lok' Pixab ri Dios ri Tz'ibtalic: “In quinc'äjisan na qui wäch, quintoj na rajil u q'uexel ri c'äx ri cäban chiwe,” —cächa ri Kajaw Dios.
Xukuje' cubij: “We cänum ri a c'ulel, chaya u wa. We cächaki'j u chi', chaya ba' ri cutijo. We je' caban wa', ri a c'ulel sibalaj cäq'uix na chawäch, cuna' c'ut chi c'äx ri xuban chawe,” —cächa'.
Maya che ri etzelal chi cäch'acan pa wi', xane are chatch'acan at puwi' ri etzelal rumal ri utzil ri cabano.
